_help: Python preset (pytest / ruff / mypy). Each gate runs in the repo root; every required gate must exit 0 before a slice can be marked verified. Adjust paths/targets to match this repo; delete gates you don't have; add coverage/integration gates you do.
session_budget_hint: A slice should fit one agent session: ~1 vertical behavior, < ~10 files touched, tests included. If it won't fit in your head, split it.
